description: Hello! We are Toprak and Berk. We are interested in the planets of the Solar System and even exoplanets. But specifically, Mars.
summary:
We prepared a website that tells us the story of the Viking Project and Apollo 11 mission. First, we added photos of Mars and the Moon and added a fun fact about how Mars got its name. We wrote some facts about the Viking Project and mentioned what it had done for us, such as how it mapped the surface of Mars and how many photos it got. How they were shut down and how long they have operated for is also added. We also added various pictures taken from the Viking landers and added a 3D Mars model.


For the Moon, we put a NASA video about how the Moon formed (theory). We mentioned the importance of Apollo 11 and what was left behind after the astronauts left. There is a 3D Model of Moon too in our website.

We didn’t use any AI. Its %100 human made. The students are competing in this project, not just to win but to also work on their communication skills and gain something from this. I’m not against AI. Im against the use of AI in the generative field. It shouldn’t replace humans, it should help us learning how to make something, not make something for us.
details: We made a free website that tells us the story of abandoned hardware on the surface of Mars and the Moon. We used Canva to make the website. We took inspiration from a template; didn't use one. We also didn't use AI because we are doing this to show what WE can do, not what AI did for us. We also added 3D Models and a video how the Moon formed (theory)
